section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 2, which conducted a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the 10-item BAS-2 across two sample types: college students (N=263) and online community participants from Amazon Mechanical Turk (N=317). The study tested whether the BAS-2 single-factor model would fit both samples and examined measurement invariance across sex (women and men) and sample type. Study 3 is also referenced with N=382 MTurk online community participants (women n=192, men n=190). The table presents standardized item-factor loadings for all BAS-2 items across Studies 1, 2 (college and community subsamples), and 3, broken down by overall sample and by gender.
